cases.name: share-below-one-row-in-a-switch-branch
cases.description: the reported shape: 10% of a five-row branch asks for half a record
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="M,F" percent="50,50"/></sequence><switch name="D" on="G"><case is="M"><mix percent="10,90"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></case><case is="F"><data>x</data></case></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: share-that-covers-a-whole-row
cases.description: 20% of the same five rows is exactly one record — nothing to say
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="M,F" percent="50,50"/></sequence><switch name="D" on="G"><case is="M"><mix percent="20,80"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></case><case is="F"><data>x</data></case></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: count-raised-until-the-share-fits
cases.description: the same 10%, over twice the rows
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="M,F" percent="50,50"/></sequence><switch name="D" on="G"><case is="M"><mix percent="10,90"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></case><case is="F"><data>x</data></case></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: share-below-one-row-at-env-level
cases.description: a mix at the top of env: the denominator is count itself

cases.name: share-below-one-row-on-a-text-generator
cases.description: a text generator writing its own shares is measured the same way
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="T"><gen type="text" value="a,b" percent="2,98"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: share-below-one-row-inside-a-parent-subset
cases.description: parent= narrows the denominator to its own subset: 2% of 30 rows
cases.config: <tdc><env count="100" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="S"><gen type="text" value="Free,Paid" percent="70,30"/></sequence><mix name="T" parent="S.Paid" percent="2,98"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: multi-key-branch-adds-the-shares-it-matches
cases.description: is="A|B" reaches 20% of the rows, so 5% of it is a whole record
cases.config: <tdc><env count="100" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="K"><gen type="text" value="A,B,C" percent="10,10,80"/></sequence><switch name="D" on="K"><case is="A|B"><mix percent="5,95"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></case><default><data>x</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: subject-that-declares-no-shares
cases.description: an even split is the default, not a statement — the denominator is unknown
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="M,F"/></sequence><switch name="D" on="G"><case is="M"><mix percent="10,90"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></case><case is="F"><data>x</data></case></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-repeat-plans-its-quota-over-elements
cases.description: repeat= draws several per row, so rows is the wrong denominator and this stays silent
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="T"><gen type="text" value="a,b" percent="70,30" repeat="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-zero-share-asks-for-nothing-on-purpose
cases.description: 0% is a deliberate absence, not a rounding accident

cases.name: a-share-for-each-option-including-the-empty-one
cases.description: `value="a,,b"` is THREE options — the run draws 100 of each over 300 rows — so a three-part percent beside it is legal. The reference used to drop the empty option before counting and refuse this as "3 entries but value has 2"; the four ports accepted it all along. A legal config was unreachable in one implementation.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="300" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,,b" percent="30,40,30"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{V}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-percent-longer-than-the-option-list-is-still-refused
cases.description: The other side of the same count: two options and three shares is a real mismatch, and counting the empty options must not soften it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="300" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b" percent="30,40,30"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{V}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-share-list-that-leaves-a-value-at-zero
cases.description: A percent shorter than the list is legal on purpose: what is left over goes to the positions nobody wrote. Here the written shares already total 100, so "c" is declared and can never be drawn — measured over 300 rows: 150 a, 150 b, no c, and check called it valid. A warning rather than a refusal, because the run is well defined and somebody may mean it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" percent="50,50"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-zero-share-written-out-is-not-warned-about
cases.description: The counter-case that keeps the warning worth reading: percent="50,0,50" says "never this one" in as many words. Answering a clear statement with a warning is how a gate teaches people to ignore it, so only an INFERRED zero is reported.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" percent="50,0,50"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
